records.label: spacr.qt.sound_synth#2
records.source: The reference theme, :data:`ORBIT`, is melodic space house in A minor: warm detuned-saw pads, plucked arpeggio notes with a dotted-eighth ping-pong delay, a soft sub, a long dark reverb, and — in the music bed alone, never in an interface sound — a quiet four-on-the-floor kick and an eighth-note shaker that come and go with the arrangement. Clicks and hovers are short plucks on notes of the scale, a finished run is an arpeggio rising through the seventh chord into the tonic under a pad swell, and a failed run is a slower falling figure over the minor fourth.
records.context: The reference theme, :data:`ORBIT`, is melodic space house in A minor: warm detuned-saw pads, plucked arpeggio notes with a dotted-eighth ping-pong delay, a soft sub, a long dark reverb, and — in the music bed alone, never in an interface sound — a quiet four-on-the-floor kick and an eighth-note shaker that come and go with the arrangement. Clicks and hovers are short plucks on notes of the scale, a finished processing session is an arpeggio rising through the seventh chord into the tonic under a pad swell, and a failed processing session is a slower falling figure over the minor fourth.
records.translation: 参考主题 :data:`ORBIT` 是 A 小调的旋律性太空浩室音乐：温暖的失谐锯齿波铺底，带附点八分音符乒乓延迟的拨奏琶音，柔和的超低音，悠长幽暗的混响，以及——仅在背景音乐中，绝不出现在界面音效中——随编排出现和消失的轻柔四四拍底鼓和八分音符沙锤。点击和悬停是音阶音符上的短促拨奏，运行完成是一段穿过七和弦上行至主音的琶音，下方伴有铺底渐强，运行失败则是在小四度上较慢的下行音型。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.sound_synth#3
records.source: This module is Qt-free on purpose. It writes 16-bit PCM WAV files, which is all :class:`PySide6.QtMultimedia.QSoundEffect` needs, into a cache under the spaCR data directory (:func:`sound_cache_root`), one folder per theme and fingerprint so a changed theme or a new synthesiser version can never be answered from a stale file. :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` renders through :func:`ensure_rendered` on its own audio thread and never on the GUI thread.
records.context: This module is Qt-free on purpose. It writes 16-bit PCM WAV files, which is all :class:`PySide6.QtMultimedia.QSoundEffect` needs, into a cache under the spaCR data directory (:func:`sound_cache_root`), one folder per theme and fingerprint so a changed theme or a new synthesiser version can never be answered from a stale file. :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` renders through :func:`ensure_rendered` on its own audio independent execution path and never on the main GUI execution path.
records.translation: 本模块特意不依赖 Qt。它写出 16-bit PCM WAV 文件——这就是 :class:`PySide6.QtMultimedia.QSoundEffect` 所需的全部——到 spaCR 数据目录下的缓存中（:func:`sound_cache_root`），每个主题和指纹一个文件夹，因此更改过的主题或新版本的合成器永远不会用过期的文件作答。:mod:`spacr.qt.sound` 在其自己的音频线程上通过 :func:`ensure_rendered` 进行渲染，绝不在 GUI 线程上进行。

records.source: ``button_accent`` is the same blue on every theme (see :data:`CONSTANT_ROLES`), and as a fill or an outline it is. As the ink of an outlined button's caption it is not readable on a light page: #4A9EFF on the light theme's page is about 2.2:1, and on Glass's lightest panel it is 3.9:1. The ink itself is the last resort, which clears it on any theme that passes its own contrast rules.
